carmen: Onboarding ZephyrX (Gemma family) AWQ-int4. Short prompts fine, long-doc QA collapse.

yusuf: numbers + convert command?

carmen: fp16 rougeL 44.8 / qa-f1 70.4. awq-int4 -> rougeL 35.4 / qa-f1 59.6. ran: `tools/awq_convert --in zephyrx.fp16 --out zephyrx.awq4 --bits 4 --g 64 --perchannel`

elsa: Any odd decodes or repeated tokens in long outputs?

carmen: yes, saw sequences with ZWNJ/ZWJ and odd ligature splits, e.g. ids [50312, 50313] -> ["\u200c", "ing"] where we expect "ing" alone.

yusuf: Could be tokenizer normalization mismatch + rotary param nuance. Which rotary mode did the exporter use?

carmen: metadata said `rotary: fractional_shared` (shared base + tiny per-head delta). our AWQ pipeline only supports `shared` or `per_head`.

elsa: fractional_shared would produce tiny per-head phase offsets; AWQ noise can amplify that across long contexts. Also if tokenizer uses NFKC vs our NFD, some multi-codepoint sequences get appended or split, shifting special ids.

yusuf: quick mitigation: re-run convert with `--rotary-mode fractional_shared` handling (patched locally) and force tokenizer normalization to NFKC during conversion. Any quick numbers?

carmen: local try: awq after fractional handling + `--tokenizer ./tokenizer.json --normalize NFKC` -> rougeL 42.1 / qa-f1 67.9. much closer.

ci-bot: nightly-evals/6543219876 complete: fp16=44.8 awq(naive)=35.4 awq(fractional+nfkc)=42.1.

yusuf: Good signal. We should: 1) teach converters to detect fractional_shared automatically (probe rotary params), 2) require explicit tokenizer path and normalization arg, 3) add tail-decoding smoke tests comparing decoded tokens for last 20 ids against upstream.

elsa: I'll add a tiny rotary-probe: compute per-head mean abs((per_head - shared) / shared) and if > 1e-4 treat as fractional_shared. It runs in ~4s.

yusuf: Also add unicode-normalization unit that runs on a failing transcript and checks codepoint sequences before/after conversion.

carmen: I'll open a PR with probe + tokenizer arg + two tests and attach a short failing example from ZephyrX archive.

ci-bot: pr/3633 created by carmen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-tools/pull/3633 (fractional_shared rotary probe + tokenizer normalization + tail-decoding + unicode tests).

carmen: After PR merged and re-run across full benchmark: awq-int4 rougeL 42.7 / qa-f1 68.2. long-doc hallucinations reduced ~54%. Closing for now.
